resolution: resolve(country, rule_code, on_date) -> newest ACTIVE version where effective_from<=date<=effective_to(or open); else explicit error (no hidden default).
invariants: one ACTIVE rule per (country, rule_code) at any date
change of law = new version, not edit; old becomes superseded
no hard-coded rate/threshold/limit/deduction/contribution/deadline/document anywhere in the engine
